hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Bengaluru's Beloved South Indian Flavors
hero.subtitle: Experience the legendary Benne Dose and authentic delicacies that have delighted generations since 1920.

about.title: The Enduring Legacy of Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: CTR, also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, Central Tiffin Room has been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and carried forward by Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition. We proudly serve Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose, an emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together, delivering the same delicious taste and vintage charm for over 104 years, thanks to the boundless love and support of our patrons.
